AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Moustate bandit
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] never takes off this mask in front of others, for various reasons. [PAWN_pronoun] harbors a strong sense of hostility towards the Moustate settlements, but nobody asks why, and nobody dares to question [PAWN_nameDef] about it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Moustate impermanence
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hated everything about Moustate, so one day [PAWN_pronoun] took up arms and killed the manatwar in the village who made the announcement, and became one of many wanted men.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Moustate ripper
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Whether employed with others, whether they want to be so, [PAWN_nameDef] does not know how many different people have fallen under the knife, [PAWN_pronoun] is always looking for the next victim. Long-term abnormal life so that [PAWN_nameDef] has already lost humanity, their own death and life have long been indifferent.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Moustate bandit boss
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the leader of a gang, and unlike his opponents, who have some bitter grudge, [PAWN_nameDef] just likes to kill people and get away with things; Under the operation of [PAWN_pronoun], a mob of people who were originally supposed to fall and scatter were led up and became a gang that gave people in this area a headache.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Moustate DaWang
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef's] family had been a family of military attaches in the days when the court was still in power, and [PAWN_pronoun] scorned the so-called "Moustate" of this rebellious mob, which would one day be exterminated.
